setup: Launch an isolated copy of original main and locked dependencies. Use original title/mode/character/stage menus to reach an enabled in-fight menu; record all UI input and configuration. Do not force root or menu frames.

phases.input: Native Enter up to open pause menu; wait without input
phases.require: menu_keyup with enabled guard, visible frame1, selection2; no Button2009 entry

phases.input: Native Up down/up, then Enter down/up
phases.require: selection1 then authored menu_play_branch; natural frame10 entry

phases.input: No keys or mouse events for a recorded wall-clock interval
phases.require: frame10 stays active; zero button entries and zero native input dispatch
independent native input record plus exact enter_entry; record actual ordering, menu visibility and frame transitions without assuming listener order

phases.input: Reopen via original menu if hidden; select1 with Up and Enter; wait for natural frame10
phases.require: new frame10 arrival; no forced goto or handler invocation
zero release_entry and zero mouse input

phases.input: Use a fresh screenshot to locate live Button2009; mouse down/up inside its hit area
phases.require: independent mouse down/up plus release_entry at live frame10

phases.input: Observe target frame1 and wait without input
phases.require: frame1 depth5 occupant independently inspected; no inference of handler return

acceptance: All phases need full ordered native records, input action log, source/build/player hashes, live slot correlation, and original/observed opcode projection. Source preparation alone is never entry proof.
